legal.title: Legal
legal.intro: Ventaja is a football statistical analysis tool. It is not a sportsbook, does not accept bets and does not process betting-related money.
legal.age: The service is intended exclusively for people aged 21 or older.
legal.responsible: Probabilities are estimates from a statistical model and do not guarantee results. If gambling stops being entertainment, seek help: 1-800-GAMBLER (US).
legal.data: We store your email, language and account dates to operate the service. We do not sell your data. You can request account deletion by messaging us on WhatsApp.
legal.sources: Statistics from API-Football and informational odds from The Odds API. Ventaja has no commercial ties to any sportsbook and includes no affiliate links.
legal.subscription: Access is activated manually after payment agreed via WhatsApp. The subscription covers use of the analysis tool and can be cancelled at any time.
